channel.title: Awesome Trustworthy Jev — Papers
channel.description: Jev research papers, ordered by first public publication date.

item.title: Calibrated Decisions Are Not Calibrated Probabilities: An Exact-Target Audit of Jev and Three Open Decision Models
item.description: Audits exact probability targets and human disagreement: normalized Noul better tracks stated base rates, while per-task calibration narrows the gap on human-vote distributions.

item.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
item.description: Benchmarks agents that build reusable artifacts for large workloads; most runs lose quality relative to zero-shot calls, while selected artifacts approach Jev at lower projected API cost.

item.title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge
item.description: Holds arithmetic and operand values fixed while swapping financial citations; Jev misses some wrong-role evidence and rejects some equivalent evidence, with column rendering changing the trade-off.

item.title: Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via System One-Guided Computational Division of Labor
item.description: Uses a Laya controller, compact evidence reader and bounded task menus to coordinate LLM workers; reports lower GPT token use and end-to-end latency across seven benchmarks.

item.title: When Plans Change Answers: Formalizing Cost-Accuracy Optimization for Semantic Queries
item.description: Formalizes semantic-query cost and output quality using contribution-weighted decision errors; simulated plan-dependent calibration can break otherwise equivalent query rewrites.

item.title: Benchmarking System One Models in Online Moderation
item.description: Separates moderation rules, retrieved precedents and answer inventories across five benchmarks; Jev benefits from precedents in matched settings, while Laya often changes its operating point without better discrimination.

item.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
item.description: Trains typed readouts after repeated backbone loops; eight loops improve accuracy at fixed model shape, but cost more compute and calibrate worse than three loops.

item.title: Readout Stability in Prefill-Only Decision Models:Zero-Label Prediction and Inference-Time Compute Allocation
item.description: Tests cached first-pass rankings under candidate-menu changes and compares re-asking with model cascades; ranking stability supports computation reuse but does not itself identify unlabeled accuracy.

item.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
item.description: Scores Turkish answer options independently at shared positions to remove order effects; supervised training beats the tested REINFORCE variant, while temperature calibration degrades on held-out question types.

item.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
item.description: Replicates seven annotation and scaling studies: Jev is faster, matches or approaches comparison models on several tasks, and has no price advantage over the reported batch-rate baseline.

item.title: SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops
item.description: Audits 139 network-control paper families and separates decision latency from verified service completion; queueing and coverage checks can reverse admission decisions.

item.title: GraphDecide: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
item.description: Benchmarks graph structure, graph-text evidence and sequential optimization across fourteen model-interface configurations; Jev benefits from heuristic proposals but gains over fixed rules depend on the task.

item.title: Hidden Risks of Jev: An Empirical Study of Security, Privacy, and Dual Use
item.description: Studies input manipulation, constrained-output privacy and defensive detection; official Jev API experiments and controlled NanoJev training experiments expose distinct risks.

item.title: System One Models for Wireless Decision-Making:Applications and Performance Evaluation
item.description: Measures the quality/latency trade-off in antenna selection and RAN slicing: Jev responds faster, while utility gains depend on the task and execution costs.

item.title: Benchmarking Candidate Coverage in Typed Decision Models
item.description: Pairs present and omitted reference labels at matched candidate counts; Jev and Laya show task-dependent detection versus false-rejection trade-offs.

item.title: To Jev or Not? Evaluating the Accuracy and Efficiency of Structured Decision Models for Hate-Speech Moderation
item.description: Compares six decision-model configurations for hate-speech moderation; supplied definitions and question decomposition do not consistently improve agreement with labels.

item.title: SecJev: Bringing Security Expertise to System One Decision Models
item.description: Specializes a shared candidate scorer with security LoRA adapters; strong in-domain gains coexist with limited latency gains over one-token generation and transfer false alarms.

item.title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
item.description: Studies when existing LLMs already support Jev-style decisions.

item.title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks
item.description: Uses Jev and a rule gate to triage simulated water-network alarms, reducing the workload passed to an LLM reviewer.

item.title: Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation
item.description: Separates evaluating supplied consequences from simulating missing ones.

item.title: Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection
item.description: Evaluates typed intrusion decisions with limited labels on an NSL-KDD pilot; the study does not establish performance on live network traffic.

item.title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
item.description: Audits missing knowledge with paired evidence interventions.

item.title: Tron-1B: Fast, Calibrated Typed Decisions with a Set-Attention Option Head
item.description: Introduces a bidirectional encoder with a set-attention option head; benchmark-trained results are compared with a zero-shot hosted service.

item.title: AnyJev Technical Report
item.description: Reads option probabilities from pretrained LLMs and corrects label and position bias with prior normalization and cyclic option rotations.

item.title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
item.description: Explores compositional action spaces for fast agent inference.

item.title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
item.description: Studies candidate-conditioned multimodal decisions against a matched generative baseline, reporting improved calibration with task-dependent accuracy trade-offs.

item.title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
item.description: Jev is faster than the tested LLM but trails trained trees on traffic classification.

item.title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
item.description: Finds an arithmetic rejection bottleneck despite an explicit fallback option.

item.title: Bongard: Training Machine Intuition
item.description: Trains an open System One model with outcome feedback.

item.title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
item.description: Implements a third-party calibrated-decision reinforcement objective.

item.title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
item.description: Measures ordinal scale compression as candidate counts grow.

item.title: Confident Where People Disagree: A preregistered, bias-corrected test of whether TypeSafe AI’s Jev lowers its confidence when humans disagree, on ChaosNLI
item.description: Tests confidence under human disagreement with bias-corrected calibration.

item.title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
item.description: Compares typed models, trained classifiers and LLM readouts under matched requests.

item.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
item.description: Evaluates Jev across public classification, routing and reasoning datasets. Calibration and selective prediction vary with the task and decision interface.

item.title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
item.description: Develops a System One model for Chinese-language tasks.

item.title: A Noul Log Does Not Identify the Policy
item.description: Shows why marginal Noul probabilities do not identify a conjunction policy.

item.title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
item.description: Audits persona and language effects despite highly repeatable answers.

item.title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
item.description: Adds an action-description encoder to an LLM and evaluates frozen-backbone and joint reinforcement learning for typed decisions.

item.title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
item.description: Uses atomic output tokens for fast structured decisions.

item.title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
item.description: Combines raw records with fast judgments and slower reasoning.

item.title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
item.description: Introduces Sys1Cal-v1 with probabilities known by construction, exposing differences between Choice, Noul and Score outputs.

item.title: The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation
item.description: Separates source attribution from the quality of a fixed argument.

item.title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
item.description: Studies action-centric representations and decision memory for navigation.

item.title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
item.description: Uses Jev to classify code weaknesses and guide a repair model. Repairs improve results under the benchmark’s insecure-code detector.

item.title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security: An Empirical Comparison with Generative LLM Judges
item.description: Compares Jev with generative judges on agent-trajectory security benchmarks, examining detection quality, valid outputs and inference cost.

item.title: When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model
item.description: Tests raw-turn selection against extraction under controlled memory budgets.

item.title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
item.description: Compares anomaly decision readouts under fixed video-derived evidence.

item.title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
item.description: Links exact posteriors, equivalent requests and action-sensitive loss.

item.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation
item.description: Audits Jev 1.13 accuracy, calibration, selective prediction and unanswerable-question handling across four medical benchmarks.

item.title: Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence
item.description: Compares direct and hierarchical decisions on matched items.

item.title: JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer
item.description: Tests local candidate-likelihood inference with shared computation.

item.title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
item.description: Audits calibration and selective escalation in an open decision model.

item.title: Type-Safe Decision Frameworks for Agentic 5G Control: A Theory-Driven Testbed Characterization of Where They Can Be Applied
item.description: Maps when typed decision gates are applicable to network control.

item.title: COGNIT-Guard: Calibrated Standalone Direct-Decision Guardrails with Heterogeneous CPU-NPU Confidence Cascading under Explicit Latency and False-Positive Constraints
item.description: Combines a calibrated CPU gate with a Laya CPU-NPU cascade for prompt safety, measuring false positives, latency and out-of-domain transfer.

item.title: You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement
item.description: Uses typed decisions in local demonstration refinement.

item.title: Evaluating System One Models for Agent Security Decisions: Reliability, Calibration, and Selective Automation
item.description: Compares security judgments across attack groups and tests confidence-based escalation. Aggregate calibration can hide groups with more missed attacks.

item.title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
item.description: Tests logical probability coherence without needing class labels.

item.title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
item.description: Uses paired evidence and permutation constraints to improve typed-readout robustness.

item.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
item.description: Audits the first research wave and its evaluation practices.

item.title: Jev at the Agent Authorization Boundary: Evaluating TypeSafe’s Decision Model on Allow, Hold, and Deny
item.description: Evaluates allow, hold and deny against authored policy specifications.

item.title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
item.description: Introduces an adversarial benchmark that compares single-field perturbations with repeated clean requests, separating attack effects from output noise.

item.title: JevSoup: System-One Routing for Training-Free LoRA Composition
item.description: Routes and combines LoRA experts using typed choices.

item.title: LAVOIR: Teaching a Single-Pass Decision Encoder When and What to Ask with Amortized Value of Information
item.description: Learns which missing information is worth asking for.

item.title: How far can a commercial decision model’s probabilities be trusted? A calibration audit of Jev against open and general-purpose classifiers
item.description: Audits task-specific calibration and label-wording sensitivity.

item.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
item.description: Optimizes ordinary-looking context to redirect initially correct decisions.

item.title: Jev in the Wild: A Data-Driven Analysis of the Jev Model's Functionality, Applications and Ecosystem
item.description: Maps decision interfaces and adoption across 2,170 public projects.

item.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
item.description: Separates VLM planning from typed GUI execution.

item.title: JEV vs. LLMs as Rubric Judges: Cheaper, Faster, and Wrong in the Same Places
item.description: Correlated errors limit the accuracy benefit of judge cascades.

item.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
item.description: Evaluates zero-shot detection of ten alignment-failure families.

item.title: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
item.description: Studies visual choice readouts with matched generation baselines.

item.title: Calibrated Decision Models for Autonomous Penetration-Testing Harnesses: JEV and Laya as System One Decision Layers for LLM-Driven Pentest Agents
item.description: Explores typed decision layers for pentest finding validation and triage.

item.title: Harness Tokenomics: A Router for the Enterprise Agentic Control Plane
item.description: Models routing economics with session-level cache effects.

item.title: Jev in Practice: A Composable Python Toolkit for TypeSafe’s System One Decision Model
item.description: Provides composable tooling, calibration utilities and recorded API experiments.

item.title: Decision Hijacking: Prompt Injection Attacks on Jev's Typed Probabilistic Decisions
item.description: Measures injection-driven probability shifts and validated targeted decisions.

item.title: NumericJev: Jev-like LLM Numerical Decoding with Multiway Decision Trees
item.description: Uses multiway decision trees for numerical readout.

item.title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: Evaluating JEV and Language Models for Legal Document Understanding
item.description: Shows that aggregate accuracy and repeated agreement hide item-level failures.

item.title: Typed Decisions at the Edge: A Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Architecture for Everyday Decision Support
item.description: Studies a privacy-oriented typed interface and deterministic fallback.

item.title: When a Judgment Layer's Self-Reported Fields Lie: Cost, Latency and the Failure Boundary of Three Judgment Layers on the Same Items
item.description: Audits judgment-layer costs, latency and self-reported fields; separates access-layer defects from model errors and tests paired error complementarity.

item.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: A Constrained Decision Head Follows the Option Name, Not the Rubric Bound to It
item.description: Tests whether option names override their attached rubrics.

item.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
item.description: Studies confidence-based acceptance and escalation for model judging.

item.title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents
item.description: Tests selective agent control and near-valid action alternatives.

item.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
item.description: Compares visual decision heads with matched generation baselines. Shared computation improves efficiency, while dedicated heads do not consistently improve accuracy.

item.title: Universal Fractal Natural Language Decision Map: Real-Time Edge Triage Across Heterogeneous Domains
item.description: Reports an alternative edge decision implementation and benchmark comparison.

item.title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
item.description: Separates semantic choices, intermediate calculations and final labels to reveal errors that a final-answer score can hide.

item.title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
item.description: Compares decision models with LLMs on text annotation; confidence-based routing helps on some tasks but high confidence can conceal task-specific errors.

item.title: Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)
item.description: Audits Jev probabilities against blinded human labels and tests recalibration, probability-grid resolution and review-budget allocation.

item.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
item.description: Places a typed decision controller inside agent memory.

item.title: Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model
item.description: Evaluates an open typed readout for scam-call screening.

item.title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
item.description: Provides an open model with a native typed decision interface.

item.title: Fast Intent-Driven Service Orchestration with Jev for 6G Edge Networks
item.description: Studies how decision latency affects bounded service orchestration.

item.title: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration
item.description: Measures typed decisions in deadline-constrained service admission.

item.title: Calibration Does Not Compose, Types Destroy Vagueness: The Hidden-Markov and Fuzzy Primitives Missing from System-One Decision Models
item.description: Analyzes how latent regime shifts and repeated thresholds can invalidate composed decision pipelines, using formal assumptions and synthetic experiments.
